observe --help.out:
usage: orinyx observe [-h] [--field FIELD] [--tool TOOL]
                      [--tool-version TOOL_VERSION] [--check-interactions]
                      [--json]
                      paths [paths ...]

Read an agent's saved output and verify every order in it, one run per record.
.txt: the file is one record, one order per line. .jsonl / .json: each
record's --field holds a list of orders or one string of them, one per line. A
directory reads its .txt, .jsonl and .json files. Synthetic test data only: a
record that looks like it holds a patient identifier refuses the whole run
before anything is sent.

positional arguments:
  paths                 files or directories

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --field FIELD         dotted path to the orders in each JSON record
                        (default: orders)
  --tool TOOL           name of the AI tool whose output is being tested
  --tool-version TOOL_VERSION
                        its version
  --check-interactions
  --json                print the runs as JSON
